title: 대한민국학술원 및 대한민국예술원의 회원수당 지급 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 대한민국학술원 및 대한민국예술원의 회원수당 지급 규정
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters concerning allowances payable to members of the National Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Korea (hereinafter referred to as the "Academy of Sciences") and the National Academy of Arts of the Republic of Korea (hereinafter referred to as the "Academy of Arts") pursuant to Article 7 (2) of the National Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Korea Act and Article 7 (2) of the National Academy of Arts of the Republic of Korea Act, respectively.
